record.paper_title: 25 Open Questions About Vector Bundles and Their Moduli
record.context_brief: Wall-crossing for holomorphic triples on genus-2 curves
record.original_question: For genus-2 curves and fixed numerical data of a holomorphic triple T = (E1, E2, f), determine the wall-crossing picture for α-stability: what is the configuration of walls given by the critical values α_i, and what are the limiting moduli spaces as α → 0^+ and α → +∞?

evidence.quote: Question 13. What is the configuration of walls and what are the limits to +∞ and to 0+ for genus 2 curves? (it should not depend on the genus 2 curve).
Let T (X, r1, r2, d1, d2, α) denote the set of (equivalence classes of) holomorphic triples with ranks r1, r2 and degrees d1, d2.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a smooth complex projective curve of genus 2. A holomorphic triple on X is a triple T = (E_1, E_2, f), where E_1 and E_2 are holomorphic vector bundles on X of ranks r_1, r_2 and degrees d_1, d_2 respectively, and f : E_2 → E_1 is a holomorphic bundle map. For a real parameter α, define the α-slope of T by

  μ_α(T) = (d_1 + d_2)/(r_1 + r_2) + α · r_2/(r_1 + r_2).

A triple T is α-(semi)stable if for every proper subtriple T' = (E'_1, E'_2, f|_{E'_2}) (with f(E'_2) ⊆ E'_1), one has μ_α(T') < μ_α(T) (resp. ≤). For fixed numerical type (r_1, r_2, d_1, d_2), let 𝒯(X, r_1, r_2, d_1, d_2, α) denote the moduli space of S-equivalence classes of α-semistable holomorphic triples of this type. As α varies in ℝ_{>0}, the moduli space changes only at finitely many critical values α_i (the "walls").

Determine, for an arbitrary smooth genus-2 curve X and arbitrary fixed (r_1, r_2, d_1, d_2):

(a) the configuration of all critical values (walls) α_i for α-stability;
(b) the structure of the limiting moduli space 𝒯(X, r_1, r_2, d_1, d_2, α) as α → 0^+;
(c) the structure of the limiting moduli space 𝒯(X, r_1, r_2, d_1, d_2, α) as α → +∞.

The answer is expected to be independent of the choice of genus-2 curve X.
artifact.status_search_result: A general framework for α-stability and wall-crossing of holomorphic triples (and chains) on curves exists, with detailed results in higher genus and for chain quiver bundles. However, no source found provides a complete description of the wall configuration and the α → 0^+ and α → +∞ limits specifically for general numerical type on genus-2 curves; the question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Quiver bundles and wall crossing for chains
status_evidence.snippet: Wall-crossing analysis for chains/triples in general settings.
status_evidence.claim: General wall-crossing theory exists but does not settle the genus-2 triple case in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Moduli spaces of holomorphic triples (Cent. Eur. J. Math.)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses α-stability and moduli of triples.
status_evidence.claim: Earlier studies of triples leave the explicit genus-2 wall configuration unaddressed.
